why_null: Considered all four cases in the library at motif level; none matches at the conservative threshold, so the panel is withheld. The shape in this narrative is a conditional projection traveling as a finished count: three of the four steps in the spine carry no source, the one supported edge jumps from defunding straight to the 2030 total, and the quantities the chain rests on are counterfactual rather than documentary, namely how much of the stopped caseload other funders and health ministries absorb (h4), how the attribution divides among the co-financiers of the same programmes (h6), and how deep the cut runs and how long it holds across the horizon (h7). B-01, casualty-inflation cascade, May 2019: the shared element is a large mortality number that outruns any correction, which is topic overlap and not motif. B-01 turns on a count with no document behind it; the count here arrives with a named source, an as-of date of June 2025 and an uncertainty interval printed beside the central figure, and what the claim map records is intermediate steps dropped in transit, not a number appearing without a document. B-02, provisions attributed to a bill whose final text was not yet public, Oct 2020: that motif needs a text no reader could open, so the gap sits between the telling and an unavailable document. Here the study is published and its methods are inspectable; the gap sits between a model's stated conditions and the figure's later travel without them. B-03, moral-shock acceleration, Aug 2025: the motif is speed, a single image mobilising within hours. This spine has no acceleration element anywhere in it and terminates at a 2030 horizon. Shared register of consequence is not a shared shape. B-04, scope-inflation panic, Jan 2025: the closest candidate and still short of the threshold. B-04 requires a narrowing instrument, a rule written to cover a small set and told as covering the whole basket, where the mismatch is checkable against the instrument's own text. This narrative has no narrowing instrument and no written limit that the telling runs past. A projection whose conditions stay behind in the methods is a different structure from a scope widened past a stated boundary, and treating the two as one would mean reading topic adjacency, big mortality figures plus a government funding decision, as motif. Blueprint D-15 permits silence, and the single echo expected in this demo set pairs B-04 with the PPN narrative, not with this one.
